title: arenaria dawsonensis var. litorea
intro: Arenaria dawsonensis var. litorea, commonly known as coastal sandwort, is a plant species within the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, which may help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Arenaria dawsonensis var. litorea are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-documented, but it is believed to contain flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
